About K2 Curtains and Trading

Abu Dhabi's trusted curtain and home décor specialist. For over 16 years, we have been helping homeowners dress their windows, refresh their furniture, and transform their living spaces with quality craftsmanship and personal service.

Our Story

K2 Curtains and Trading was founded in 2010 with a simple mission: to give Abu Dhabi homeowners access to beautiful, made-to-measure curtains and blinds without the hassle of visiting multiple shops. We believed that choosing window treatments should be enjoyable, not overwhelming — and that the best way to do that is to bring the showroom to your door.

Based on Hamdan Street in the Ziyani Area, we operate from a fully equipped workshop where our team of tailors, installers, and designers craft every curtain, blind, and upholstered piece by hand. This means we control quality from the first measurement to the final stitch.

Over the years, we have fitted curtains and blinds in thousands of homes across Abu Dhabi — from villas in Al Shamkha and Baniyas to apartments on Yas Island and Al Raha. We have reupholstered family sofas, installed wooden flooring in new builds, and built traditional Arabic majlis seating that becomes the heart of the home.

Our approach is simple: listen to what you need, recommend the right fabrics and finishes, deliver on time, and stand behind every product we install. That is why our clients recommend us to their neighbours, families, and friends.

K2 Curtains and Trading

Curtains, Blinds & Home Décor

We specialize in custom curtains, Roman and roller blinds, Venetian blinds, motorized smart curtains, sofa upholstery, wooden flooring, carpets and rugs, designer wallpapers, and Arabic majlis seating. Every project starts with a free home consultation and ends with a quality-checked installation.

Our team combines interior design expertise with hands-on craftsmanship, allowing us to handle everything from a single bedroom blind to a complete villa makeover — curtains, flooring, upholstery, and more.
